item.title: Week 10: Bills at Jets
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -8.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model NYJ 33% vs. market 20% | On paper, Buffalo has the edge, led by its passing game: it ranks 9th in EPA per dropback (+0.17) against a Jets defense ranked 31st (+0.09 allowed). The Jets' best counter is run defense, ranked 16th in stuff rate (18% generated). Josh Allen ranks 10th of 31 in EPA per dropback, ahead of Geno Smith at 17th, and Khalil Shakir, averaging 4.4 yards of separation (2nd of 76), is the x-factor against a Jets pass defense ranked 31st. The model also favors Buffalo at 67% win probability, driven by a passing matchup worth 3.8 points and a rushing matchup worth 2.1 points.
